unlisted_practices: Benchmarking LLMs on static diagnostic inference versus dynamic multi-turn psychiatric consultation using synthetic EMR-aligned patient simulations
Evaluating consultation quality with LLM-as-a-Judge and comparing it with diagnostic accuracy

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates a benchmark (LingxiDiagBench) consisting of multi-agent LLM simulations to assess diagnostic accuracy and multi-turn psychiatric consultation capabilities across multiple LLMs without testing a specific health care deployment safeguard/practice.
